name: Daurthecht
text: Daurthecht is a variant spelling of the name Durthacht. The dictionary files it as a pointer to that record. Durthacht is the father of Eógan mac Durthacht, an Ulster figure. Readers should follow the Eógan mac Durthacht entry for the family dossier.
